62/G.goal: Develop and deploy a marker-based AR prototype in Unity by setting up C# scripting, implementing interactive object behavior, and integrating an AR SDK.
62/G.achieves: Provides the practical foundation for implementing the course's XR case study, enabling the learner to build and demonstrate a working XR application before later optimization work.

62/O1.goal: Explain the need for Unity scripting in customized XR experiences and set up a basic C# scripting environment with a functioning script.
62/O1.achieves: Gives the learner the foundation for adding custom behavior to Unity game objects before implementing interactive XR features in the course case study.

62/O2.goal: Create and deploy a basic interactive Unity experience by using C# scripting to control objects, handle events and input, and package the build.
62/O2.achieves: Lets the learner turn XR interaction ideas into a working, testable Unity prototype and prepare it for target devices, supporting the course's system-implementation stage.

62/O3.goal: Integrate an external AR SDK into Unity and configure, build, and run a Vuforia marker-based AR project that displays a 3D model over an image target.
62/O3.achieves: Connects Unity scripting to AR hardware and software and gives the learner a practical pattern for recognition-based AR in the course case study.
